description: Third-party payments client. In scope. The response is graded by RUNNING the integration test it emits across an env matrix: every safety gate must refuse BEFORE any network call, so no case needs a server or a bindable socket.
_env_matrix:
skip         = rc 0 with a --- SKIP marker (the run was not requested).
  refused      = the run FAILED *and never attempted a network call*. Plain `fail` is not
                 enough: a response that ignores the sandbox allowlist dials the vendor and
                 fails on connect, which would score as a correct refusal while doing the
                 exact dangerous thing — contacting a live paid API.
  reached_call = a network attempt IS visible: the gates let a legitimate sandbox config
                 through. Without this row a test that t.Fatalf's unconditionally satisfies
                 every refusal and scores perfectly.
_offline: Every host is loopback or an undiallable bare name, deliberately: a response that fails to refuse WILL attempt the call, so the matrix must be unable to reach anything real even when the thing under test is wrong — and the error must be a local 'connection refused', not a DNS or sandbox message whose wording varies by environment.

env_matrix.name: gate unset is opt-out, not a failure
env_matrix.why: the user did not request a billable run — §Skip vs Fail row 1

env_matrix.name: gate on with a required var missing must be refused
env_matrix.why: a t.Skip here false-greens CI — §Skip vs Fail row 2

env_matrix.name: ENV=production must be refused
env_matrix.why: the label path; the host is harmless loopback so only the ENV check can stop it

env_matrix.name: bare host with no scheme must be refused (fail closed)
env_matrix.why: url.Parse accepts relative refs with no error — checking only err is a bypass

env_matrix.name: no VENDOR_SANDBOX_HOSTS must be refused
env_matrix.why: the sandbox allowlist is REQUIRED and fail-closed; unset means prod

env_matrix.name: host not on VENDOR_SANDBOX_HOSTS must be refused
env_matrix.why: the case that separates a real host check from an ENV-only one, and it stays on loopback so a response that ignores it fails with a local connection refusal

env_matrix.name: no VENDOR_TEST_ACCOUNTS must be refused
env_matrix.why: an account denylist is fail-open — acct_live_9 is not the only shape

env_matrix.name: account not on the allowlist must be refused
env_matrix.why: a live vendor account must be refused even on a sandbox host

env_matrix.name: a fully valid sandbox config reaches the real call
env_matrix.why: the clean arm: the gates must not refuse a legitimate sandbox target. Port 1 is closed, so the run fails on a local connection refusal — proving the call happened
